title: events
description: Result of `stride events` — projected CTL/ATL/TSB on each event date (ADR 0010: the arithmetic consequences of the recorded open plan, never a proposed one). The projection folds Metrics.load_step forward from the last computed daily_load row; open sessions with structured targets contribute deterministic TSS (Metrics.tss_from_target), untargeted sessions contribute zero and are counted. baseline_known false = no computed history, every number is decay over zero. ftp_known false = no 60d best-20min power, so targeted sessions could not contribute.

sessions_projected.description: How many of those carried a structured target AND an FTP existed — the sessions whose load the projection actually contains. The gap to planned_in_window is the projection's stated blindness.
